r.문화권·종교: Kazakh and Russian · Muslim and Orthodox
r.주식시장 시가총액: $158.4 billion, 52% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.주요 수출품: Crude oil 54%, Inorganic chemicals 6%, Copper ore 6%, Refined copper 5%, Iron and steel 5% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 56%, Car parts 15%, Machinery, computers 6%, Cosmetics 4% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Crude oil 81%, Ferroalloys 9%, Inorganic chemicals 5%, Zinc 2% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: Power is concentrated in the presidency. After mass protests in 2022, the constitution was changed to limit presidents to a single term.

t.why: A major producer of oil and uranium. Between Russia and China, it pursues multi-vector diplomacy that also reaches out to the West.
t.rel: It shares one of the longest borders in the world with Russia. A member of Russia-led economic and security blocs, it pursues 'multi-vector' diplomacy, widening ties with China and the West as well.
t.korea: More than 100,000 Koryo-saram live there, descendants of Koreans deported from the Russian Far East in 1937.
t.know: Kazakhstan's Baikonur Cosmodrome, where Gagarin launched into space in 1961, is still leased by Russia.
t.etext: It sells crude oil, uranium, copper and steel, and is the world's largest uranium producer. Most of its oil is exported through a pipeline crossing Russian territory.
